experiment: Exploratory late-layer additive Drive steering probe
implication: The tested late-layer additive Drive directions did not pass the exploratory random-control gate. This weakens the steering route for Pythia-160M and argues for either a fresh forced-choice assay or deeper path/SAE diagnostics before more generation work.
plain_english_read: This is Claude's late-layer/additive suggestion translated into a bounded logit-margin test. It is exploratory because it reuses the Stage 7 fixture rather than a fresh held-out forced-choice set.
